notes.location: Other Aeolian Landforms, Erosional Features: Ventifacts
notes.supports: Wind-driven particles abrade, polish and groove rock. Broad planar faces and ridge arrangement are an original simplified abrasion-form design.

claim_scope: Single squat original wind-abraded rock, three dominant broad planar abrasion surfaces meeting at sharp ridges; smaller basal broken facets subordinate. No locality, geological age or measured natural dimension. Clay must show main facets as geometry, not painted patterns.
